sec.title: September 6 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 862)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 6** across two antiquities and jewel theft mysteries on *The Casebook of Gregory Hood* (1948, 1949), Terry Pratchett's comic Discworld fantasy *Guards! Guards!* produced by the Atlanta Radio Theatre Company (2007), eccentric inheritance comedy on *Knickerbocker Playhouse* (1941), Napoleonic relic murder on *Mystery of the Week* (1946), and western range protection on *The Adventures of Champion* (1949).
All episode titles maintain pure canonical naming, with credited performers, conductors, and story details recorded in the narrative description:
